text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 2, 2021) for 42 Aveline Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (December 2, 2021) for 42 Aveline Crescent, Folder Number 21 243569 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to July 4, 2022.
